walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the CCEA GCSE Food Technology specification.

Diet and Health appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Diet and Health in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Diet and Health.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
